retrieval_budget.dual_speaker_semantics: K items per speaker lane; evidence coverage uses the union of lanes at the same K; no synthetic global rank
retrieval_budget.single_bank_semantics: K items from the native single ranked lane

primary_metrics.provenance_recall_at_k: Gold evidence turn recall from explicit source provenance; unavailable when a backend does not expose a source-turn mapping
primary_metrics.hit_at_k: Fraction of eligible questions with at least one gold evidence turn recovered
primary_metrics.mrr: Reciprocal rank of first provenance-supported gold evidence hit; for dual-speaker retrieval report best per-lane rank and label it per-lane MRR

gold_evidence_similarity.aggregation: cosine similarity; best retrieved fragment per gold evidence turn, then query macro and evidence micro means
gold_evidence_similarity.purpose: continuous semantic coverage for abstractive memories; never reported as strict Recall@K

primary_metrics.context_tokens: retrieved context footprint using the fixed local tokenizer in the evaluator
primary_metrics.internal_llm_tokens: memory-system write/extraction calls only; answer/judge calls excluded
primary_metrics.gold_session_recall_at_k: Supplementary only. When a backend exposes session provenance but not source-turn provenance, derive gold sessions from LoCoMo evidence turn IDs and measure recovered gold sessions at K. This is weaker than turn-level Recall@K and must be labeled session-level.

fairness.memhub_core_ab: same frozen memory snapshot; only retrieval ranking mode differs

provenance_levels.turn: Strongest: retrieved item maps to exact LoCoMo evidence turn ID; eligible for Evidence Turn Recall@K/MRR.
provenance_levels.session: Supplementary: retrieved item maps only to source session; report Gold Session Recall/Hit/MRR and never relabel as turn recall.
provenance_levels.semantic: Representation coverage only: fixed-embedding Gold Evidence Similarity; not a provenance hit.

comparability.cross_level_rule: Do not rank or numerically compare turn-level Recall@K and session-level Recall@K as if they were the same metric.
